dependency_evidence: E. microcarpa was described from and reared from Phyllanthus microcarpus (= Kirganelia microcarpa); the taxonomic paper states Epicephala species are host-specific, and the 2023 field study directly observes E. microcarpa pollination/oviposition on K. microcarpa
witness_selection_rule: Use only Table-1 sites with E. microcarpa morphologically identified among positively reared/dissected moths; exclude sites with zero reared moths and the site lacking E. microcarpa
known_boundary: Kirganelia microcarpa and Phyllanthus microcarpus are homotypic names under competing current genus treatments; taxonomy transport must be resolved separately before any occurrence read. Passing the literature declaration does not prove absolute host exclusivity outside the cited taxonomic/field evidence.
